create_defaultmodel_instance: create a DefaultModel instance from a pretrained model path with a specific device and dtype
run_embed_batch: run the DefaultModel embed method on a PaddedBatch to get text embeddings
configure_pooling_mode: configure the DefaultModel pooling mode to cls, mean, or last token pooling
check_model_capabilities: check if a DefaultModel supports position_ids or token_type_ids via inspect
get_max_input_length: get the max_input_length from a DefaultModel based on its config and model type
